    Frequently Asked Questions

    Do I need any equipment?

    Nope. All workouts are bodyweight-only. If you have resistance bands or dumbbells, we'll show you bonus variations.

    What if I miss a day?

    Life happens. You can make up workouts within 48 hours. Your streak pauses but doesn't break.

    I'm a total beginner — is this for me?

    Absolutely. Every workout has three difficulty levels. Start where you are. No judgment.

    How long are the workouts?

    20-35 minutes. No hour-long sessions. We respect your time.

    Is there a diet plan?

    We provide a flexible nutrition framework — not a rigid meal plan. Think guidelines, not rules.

    When does the challenge start?

    April 1, 2026. Prep materials are available immediately after sign-up.
